answers.1.4: Illustration: Sales planners compare the realized margin per barrel with the forecast to explain the gap.
answers.2.2: MPC's Refining & Marketing margin (sales revenue less the cost of refinery inputs and purchased products) per barrel of net refinery throughput.
answers.2.3: Sales revenue less the cost of refinery inputs and purchased products, per barrel of net refinery throughput. From 2026 the margin includes impacts from derivative activity.
answers.2.4: Inter-refinery transfer volumes, which the regional per-barrel figures leave out of net refinery throughput.
answers.2.5: Illustration: Grow the refining and marketing margin on every barrel sold.
answers.3.1: R&M margin ($) / net refinery throughput (bbl); from 2026 the margin includes impacts from derivative activity
answers.3.3: quarterly and annual, company and region
answers.3.8: Illustration: One value for each month and each refining region.
answers.3.10: Illustration: Closed accounting periods only. A month that is still open is excluded.
answers.3.11: Illustration: Reviewed each year with the plan. Retired when the segment's margin is no longer reported per barrel.
3.12: Illustration: Review level: the realized margin per barrel is below the forecast for the month.
answers.3.13: Illustration: From 2026-01-01, until it is replaced.
answers.4.8: MPC's non-GAAP realized margin per barrel of net refinery throughput, by region. A financial result measure (Parmenter's RI); MPC's bonus uses a related EBITDA measure instead. The definition changed in 2026 to include derivatives, so it is versioned.
answers.5.3: Not a crack spread: it is realized, not a market benchmark.
6.5: MPC defines R&M margin as the difference between the prices of refined products sold and the costs of crude oil and other charge and blendstocks refined, including transport to the refineries and products purchased for resale; MPC FY2025 10-K, Item 7 (reference/mpc/mpc-fy2025-10k-fact-sheet.md, section 8)
MPC reports R&M margin per barrel for 2023 to 2025; MPC FY2025 10-K, Item 7 (reference/mpc/mpc-fy2025-10k-fact-sheet.md, section 8)
